revisions.concept: Medium shot: Eli stands on the right side of the frame, amazed with an open mouth, holding up a small lit clay oil lamp inside a dark rock tunnel; a thin stream of bright blue water runs along the bare floor beside him. Nothing else. Simple dark background, clear empty top quarter, no lettering.
